g.text: The three layers of power · Trys galios sluoksniai
Gods are a fact of nature, Forces are gods grown hungry, and Kalba is the mortal craft of asking.
I · THE GODS (Dievai): source, ancient, mostly indifferent. They can be petitioned.
fuel: crusade, bought baptism, conquest without end, ledgers and tolls
III · THE CRAFT (Senovės Kalba): mortal words, mortal blood, mortal cost.
Five elements, each with its patron
The human schools that use it

They bind mortal craft only. Gods and
Forces are not bound by Truth: the
Shadow-Seller can lie, no mortal caster
